This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for wastewater infrastructure on the Red Lake Reservation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; RED LAKE BAND OF CHIPPEWA INDIANS; WASTEWATER INFRASTRUCTURE.

$3,300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the Red Lake Band of Chippewa Indians to construct a wastewater stabilization pond and associated water and sewer line infrastructure for the Little Rock District on the Red Lake Reservation. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: APPROPRIATION; RED LAKE BAND OF CHIPPEWA INDIANS; WASTEWATER INFRASTRUCTURE.

This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
